OTCQB:MIT…

children: Entrepreneur and Concordia Eco Resort owner, Tim Allen, to Guide Centcore’s TC/DC Development; Brian Moses Discusses RoboAgent’s Next-Generation Embedded Coaching Platform with SmallCapVoice’s Stuart Smith

today announced that its subsidiary, Centcore, LLC, has entered into an agreement with entrepreneur and Concordia Eco Resort owner Tim Allen to host early prototypes of Centcore's TC/DC platform at properties affiliated with Allen. In addition to serving as a deployment partner, Allen will provide strategic input on the ongoing development and commercialization of the technology.

Separately, the company's RoboAgent AI sales force automation platform is being prepared for a late fourth-quarter rollout. The solution will feature the new "Robo Coach" module, which delivers AI-driven, interpretive sales coaching based on content developed by Brian Moses (www.brianmoses.com), a recognized leader in real estate sales training. Moses recently discussed the platform's embedded coaching capabilities with Stuart Smith of SmallCapVoice, highlighting RoboAgent's potential to enhance sales performance and productivity.

The edge computing platform known as “TC/DC” is Centcore’s proposed compact, distributed data center designed to place computing capacity in non-obtrusive used locations instead of expense and complex data centers. The initial prototype installations are intended to give Centcore practical settings in which to evaluate installation, power use, operations and the suitability of different property types.

Allen founded TLA Consulting in 2009 and later established TLA AI Lab, where his work includes AI-enabled CRM, automation and growth systems. He is also the owner of Concordia Eco Resort in St. John, U.S. Virgin Islands, where he has led property redevelopment, operations and sustainability initiatives. Mitesco believes his experience with both technology-enabled operations and property management will provide useful input as Centcore develops and tests its prototypes.

“Tim brings a valuable combination of operating experience and a practical understanding of how technology must work at a real property,” said Brian Valania, Chief Executive Officer of Mitesco. “Hosting early units will help us learn from actual installations, while his consulting work will help inform the next stage of TC/DC development.”

“I’m interested in seeing how the TC/DC performs in an actual property setting,” said Allen. “Early prototypes give us a chance to identify practical requirements and help Centcore make informed decisions as the design develops.”

about the importance of RoboAgent for real estate professionals. Their discussion focused on the coaching module being developed within the platform, which is intended to provide sales guidance alongside an agent’s daily contacts, tasks and client activity. To review this key interview go to:

“Agents face decisions every day about how to follow up, move a conversation forward and serve a client,” said Moses. “The goal of embedding coaching in RoboAgent is to make useful guidance available while they’re doing that work, when they can put it into practice.” The Robo Agent application software is currently under test by a number of the most well-known, publicly held real estate agencies nationwide.
